cards.intuition: Rows sharing the grouping values collapse into one output row. The grouping columns are the new definition of what one row represents.
cards.formula: one output row per distinct grouping-key combination
cards.topic: GROUP BY Mechanics and Aggregate Functions

cards.intuition: COUNT star counts physical rows; COUNT expression counts measured values. Value aggregates ignore missing inputs rather than treating them as zero.
cards.formula: COUNT(*) includes rows; COUNT(x) excludes NULL x; AVG(x)=SUM(x)/COUNT(x)
cards.topic: GROUP BY Mechanics and Aggregate Functions

cards.intuition: If a join multiplies facts first, the aggregate faithfully totals the copies. Reduce each many-side to target grain before combining them.
cards.formula: pre-aggregate each source to target key, then join
cards.topic: GROUP BY Mechanics and Aggregate Functions

cards.intuition: WHERE chooses the source population before groups exist. HAVING tests statistics computed from completed groups.
cards.formula: FROM/JOIN → WHERE → GROUP BY/aggregate → HAVING → SELECT
cards.topic: HAVING vs WHERE: Filtering Before and After Aggregation

cards.intuition: Ask whether the condition describes an individual input row or a group result. Push row predicates early unless doing so changes the intended population.
cards.formula: row condition: WHERE; aggregate condition: HAVING
cards.topic: HAVING vs WHERE: Filtering Before and After Aggregation

cards.intuition: Build a set inside each group and count its non-missing members. Repeated values contribute once and NULL contributes zero.
cards.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT x) = cardinality of unique non-NULL x
cards.topic: COUNT DISTINCT and the Cost of Deduplication

cards.intuition: A normal count keeps one integer; a distinct count must remember or sort keys and often shuffle equal keys together across workers.
cards.formula: hash distinct state O(unique keys); sort distinct O(n log n)
cards.topic: COUNT DISTINCT and the Cost of Deduplication

cards.intuition: A person appearing on three days contributes once to each daily set but should contribute once to the month. Recompute at the requested grain.
cards.formula: sum(daily unique users) is not monthly unique users
cards.topic: COUNT DISTINCT and the Cost of Deduplication

cards.intuition: Compact sketches trade a known small error for fixed memory. Use them for trends, not billing, constraints, or exact audit denominators.
cards.formula: approximate sketch only when bounded error is acceptable
cards.topic: COUNT DISTINCT and the Cost of Deduplication

cards.intuition: One output group may contain many source values, so every selected expression needs one justified answer through grouping, aggregation, or a proven dependency.
cards.formula: selected expression → exactly one value per output group

cards.concept: MAX score does not carry its row
cards.intuition: Independent aggregates do not keep columns paired. An arbitrary document ID beside MAX(score) can describe a row that never existed.
cards.formula: MAX(score) does not imply document_id from argmax row

cards.concept: Do not fix legality by changing grain
cards.intuition: Adding a stray column to GROUP BY may silence an error while creating more output rows. Repair according to the business question.
cards.formula: extra grouping column = new, finer grain
